name: dlfs_list
description: List directory contents in a DLFS drive. Returns an array of entries, each with name, type ('file' or 'directory'), and size (for files). Omit path to list the drive root.

drive.description: Drive name, or a DID-URL reference to another user's drive (e.g. 'did:key:zOwner.../drive')

path.description: Directory path within the drive (e.g. 'docs/specs'). Omit for root directory.

ucans.description: Optional UCAN JWT proofs authorising delegated access to another user's drive
